Counsel for Applicant :- Harshit Pathak,Anurag Pathak Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Sadhna Rani (Thakur),J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. and perused the record.

This is the second bail application on behalf of the applicant Rikesh with a prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No.199 of 2022, under Sections 363, 376 & 328 of I.P.C., Section 3/4 of POCSO Act & Section 3(2) (5) of S.C./S.T. Act, Police Station Rampur Maniharan, District Saharanpur.
The first bail application of the applicant was rejected on 09.12.2022.
It is submitted that all the four witnesses of fact including the victim and the first informant have turned hostile in the trial court and have not supported the prosecution version.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 14.06.2022, hence, prayer for bail is made.
Learned A.G.A., however, opposed the prayer of bail.

sentences.text: From the perusal of the record, it is found that in the FIR the present applicant was not named but later on his name was disclosed by the victim in her statements under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C.
All the four witnesses of fact including the first informant and the victim have turned hostile in the trial court and have not supported the prosecution version.
In their cross-examination also, nothing fruitful has come before the trial court.
The victim, first informant, mother and sister of the victim i.e. all the witnesses of fact have not supported the prosecution version.

Perusing the record, considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the nature of allegations,
arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the parties and without expressing any opinion on the merit of the case, I find it to be a case of bail.
The second bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant Rikesh, who is involved in aforesaid crime be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:-
1. The applicant will attend and co-operate the trial proceedings pending before the court concerned on the dates fixed after release.
2. The applicant will not tamper with the witnesses.
3. The applicant will not indulge in any illegal activities during the bail period.

The identity, status and residential proof of sureties would be verified by the court concerned and in case of breach of any of the above conditions, the trial court shall be at liberty to cancel the bail and send the applicant to prison.

It is clarified that the observations, if any, made in this order are strictly confined to the disposal of this bail application and must not be construed to have any reflection on the ultimate merits of the case.

Order Date :- 18.9.2023 Radhika  Rikesh vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/141171595/
